text:
**Topology:** two-stage Miller-compensated OTA with an NMOS input pair and a nulling resistor.

**Why NMOS input:** the PMOS |Vth| is about 1 V. A PMOS pair at VCM = 0.9 V would need its source near 1.95 V, which is above VDD. So the pair is NMOS (M1/M2) with a PMOS current-mirror load (M3/M4) and an NMOS tail (MT).

**Bias:** IREF is sunk by the diode-connected nfet MB. MT and M6 mirror it with ratios WT/WB and W6/WB.

**Second stage:** PMOS common source (M5) with an NMOS current-sink load (M6). M5 shares L3 with the mirror so its W5/W3 ratio can match the current ratio and keep systematic offset low. Expected output swing is about 0.15 to 1.65 V.

**Compensation:** Cc with a series Rz to push the right-half-plane zero away. Rz should be near or above 1/gm5.

**Polarity:** vinp drives M1, the device on the mirror's diode side. A rise on vinp pulls n2 high, which lowers M5's current, so vout falls… that would be inverting. So vinp instead goes to M2, the gate whose drain is n2. A rise on vinp pulls n2 down, M5 turns on harder and vout rises, which makes vinp the non-inverting input.

**First-cut numbers (worst case within the parameter ranges):**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Reference | 10 µA |
| Tail | 20 µA |
| Output stage | 80–125 µA |
| Total power | ≤ ~290 µW |
| gm1 | ≈ 0.15 mS |
| Cc | 0.8 pF, giving GBW ≈ 30 MHz |
| gm5 | ≈ 1 mS, putting p2 ≈ 80 MHz |
| Gain | ≈ 40 dB + 40 dB |

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode-connected nfet sinks IREF
MB  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L={LB}
* tail current source
MT  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W={WT} L={LB}
* NMOS input pair (vinp -> M2 side whose drain drives 2nd stage => non-inverting)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W={W1} L={L1}
M2  n2 vinp tail vss nfet W={W1} L={L1}
* PMOS mirror load (diode on n1)
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W={W3} L={L3}
M4  n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W={W3} L={L3}
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink
M5  vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W={W5} L={L3}
M6  vout ibias vss vss nfet W={W6} L={LB}
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n2 nz {RZ}
Cc  nz vout {CC}
.ends dut
```
